headline: Dow Jones closes lower as markets digest inflation shock and mixed tech action
summary: US stocks finished a session mixed as investors reacted to new inflation data ahead of key peace talks. The Dow closed lower after a second week of gains for stocks.
why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US blue-chip companies and is a widely watched gauge of US equity sentiment.
why_moved: Inflation data showed price pressures that investors weighed against upcoming peace talks, pulling the index lower.
